svg.title: svrngs: same acts, same state
svg.desc: Phones and computers sign their own acts. Each act names its previous one inside its hash; copies converge by union, and admission puts them in one total order, refusing what breaks the rules by name. Folds over that order give who is in the group and each app’s state, the same on every copy. The code nests from a pure core outward to the command, forked once from commonwealth-ai and linking nothing back, and every check in scripts/check.sh failed on a planted input before it passed.
svg.text: Small enough to read in an afternoon, and checked so it stays that way.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The record: signed acts, and every copy folds them the same way
